import json
import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from checkpoint import dump_state, load_state, validate
from reducer import empty_state, apply_event
from codec import parse_event


def build_state(stock=None, requests=None, seen=None):
    state = empty_state()
    if stock is not None:
        state['stock'] = stock
    if requests is not None:
        state['requests'] = requests
    if seen is not None:
        state['seen'] = seen
    return state


class CheckpointDumpRoundTripTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_workflow_state(self):
        state = empty_state()
        state = apply_event(state, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}'))
        state = apply_event(state, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":5}'))
        state = apply_event(state, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e3","op":"reserve","request":"r1","lines":[["A",3],["B",2]]}'))
        state = apply_event(state, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e4","op":"cancel","request":"r1"}'))
        # record is retained after cancellation
        return state

    def test_round_trip_preserves_fields_and_replay(self):
        state = self.make_workflow_state()
        text = dump_state(state)
        loaded = load_state(text)
        self.assertEqual(loaded['stock'], state['stock'])
        self.assertEqual(loaded['requests'], state['requests'])
        self.assertEqual(loaded['seen'], state['seen'])
        # cancelled request replayed with fresh id still works
        loaded2 = apply_event(loaded, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e5","op":"reserve","request":"r1","lines":[["A",1],["B",1]]}'))
        self.assertIn('r1', loaded2['requests'])
        # replay of an old event is a no-op (seen precond)
        replay = apply_event(loaded, parse_event(
            '{"id":"e1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}'))
        self.assertEqual(replay['stock'], loaded['stock'])

    def test_exact_dump_format(self):
        state = empty_state()
        text = dump_state(state)
        expected = '{"version":1,"state":{"requests":{},"seen":{},"stock":{}}}\n'
        self.assertEqual(text, expected)
        self.assertTrue(text.endswith('\n'))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('\n'), 1)

    def test_insertion_order_byte_identical(self):
        state1 = {'stock': {'a': 1, 'b': 2},
                  'requests': {'r': {'a': 1}},
                  'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'a', 'qty': 1}}}
        state2 = {'requests': {},
                  'seen': {'e': {'qty': 1, 'sku': 'a', 'op': 'restock', 'id': 'e'}},
                  'stock': {'b': 2, 'a': 1}}
        # note: seen event is inserted with shuffled key order too; it must
        # still be canonical (sort_keys applies to dump but equality compares
        # dicts) so use an ordering that survives json sorting.
        self.assertEqual(dump_state(state1), dump_state(state2))

    def test_load_accepts_surrounding_whitespace(self):
        state = self.make_workflow_state()
        text = dump_state(state)
        for padded in ('\n' + text, '  ' + text + '  \n', '\t' + text):
            self.assertEqual(load_state(padded), state)

    def test_load_returns_detached_data(self):
        text = dump_state(self.make_workflow_state())
        loaded = load_state(text)
        loaded['stock']['A'] = 999
        loaded['seen']['e1']['qty'] = 999
        self.assertEqual(load_state(text)['stock']['A'], 7)  # 10-3 from e3
        self.assertEqual(load_state(text)['seen']['e1']['qty'], 10)

    def test_dump_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        state = self.make_workflow_state()
        snapshot = deepcopy(state)
        dump_state(state)
        self.assertEqual(state, snapshot)
        # nested seen event untouched
        self.assertEqual(state['seen'], snapshot['seen'])

    def test_load_does_not_mutate_text(self):
        text = dump_state(self.make_workflow_state())
        original = text
        load_state(text)
        self.assertEqual(text, original)


class CheckpointRejectTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejected(self, state, text=None):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state(state)
        if text is not None:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                load_state(text)

    def test_duplicate_wrapper_key(self):
        text = '{"version":1,"version":2,"state":{}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_duplicate_nested_key(self):
        text = ('{"version":1,"state":{"stock":{"a":1,"a":2},'
                '"requests":{},"seen":{}}}')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_extra_wrapper_key(self):
        text = '{"version":1,"state":{},"extra":true}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_missing_wrapper_key(self):
        text = '{"version":1}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_missing_state_field(self):
        text = '{"version":1,"state":{"stock":{},"requests":{}}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_extra_state_field(self):
        text = ('{"version":1,"state":{"stock":{},"requests":{},"seen":{},'
                '"extra":1}}')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_version_zero(self):
        text = '{"version":0,"state":{}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_version_two(self):
        text = '{"version":2,"state":{}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_version_boolean(self):
        text = '{"version":true,"state":{}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_version_string(self):
        text = '{"version":"1","state":{}}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_malformed_json(self):
        text = '{"version":1,"state":'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_state_not_dict(self):
        text = '{"version":1,"state":[1,2,3]}'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            load_state(text)

    def test_stock_invalid_quantity_float(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {'a': 1.5}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_stock_invalid_quantity_boolean(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {'a': True}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_stock_invalid_quantity_negative(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {'a': -1}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_stock_invalid_sku_empty(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {'': 1}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_stock_invalid_sku_boolean(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {True: 1}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_request_invalid_quantity_float(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {}, 'requests': {'r': {'a': 0.5}},
                             'seen': {}})

    def test_request_invalid_quantity_boolean(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {}, 'requests': {'r': {'a': True}},
                             'seen': {}})

    def test_request_invalid_quantity_zero(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {}, 'requests': {'r': {'a': 0}},
                             'seen': {}})

    def test_request_empty_id(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {}, 'requests': {'': {}}, 'seen': {}})

    def test_request_lines_not_dict(self):
        self.assertRejected({'stock': {}, 'requests': {'r': [('a', 1)]},
                             'seen': {}})

    def test_seen_unaggregated_reserve(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'r',
                                'lines': [['A', 1], ['A', 2]]}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_reordered_reserve(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'r',
                                'lines': [['B', 1], ['A', 1]]}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_id_mismatch(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'wrong_id': {'id': 'e1', 'op': 'restock',
                                       'sku': 'A', 'qty': 1}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_restock_boolean_qty(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'A',
                                'qty': True}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_restock_float_qty(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'A',
                                'qty': 1.5}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_reserve_boolean_qty(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'reserve', 'request': 'r',
                                'lines': [['A', True]]}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_unknown_op(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'bogus'}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_missing_id(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'A', 'qty': 1}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_seen_extra_field(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock', 'sku': 'A',
                                'qty': 1, 'extra': 1}}}
        self.assertRejected(state)

    def test_dump_invalid_state_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state({'stock': {'a': True}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dump_state({'stock': {}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': {}} if False
                       else {'stock': {}, 'requests': {}, 'seen': 'x'})


class CheckpointConsistencyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_loaded_state_verified_equal(self):
        state = apply_event(
            apply_event(empty_state(), parse_event(
                '{"id":"e1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":4}')),
            parse_event('{"id":"e2","op":"reserve","request":"r","lines":[["A",1]]}'))
        loaded = load_state(dump_state(state))
        self.assertEqual(loaded, state)

    def test_space_skus_valid_and_preserved(self):
        state = {'stock': {' pi pe\\|': 3}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock',
                                'sku': ' pi pe\\|', 'qty': 3}}}
        text = dump_state(state)
        loaded = load_state(text)
        self.assertEqual(loaded['stock'][' pi pe\\|'], 3)
        self.assertEqual(loaded['seen']['e']['sku'], ' pi pe\\|')

    def test_unicode_preserved(self):
        state = {'stock': {'sesquiél': 1}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'id': 'e', 'op': 'restock',
                                'sku': 'sesquiél', 'qty': 1}}}
        text = dump_state(state)
        self.assertIn('sesquiél', text)
        self.assertEqual(load_state(text), state)

    def test_empty_request_allowed(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {'r': {}}, 'seen': {}}
        self.assertEqual(load_state(dump_state(state)), state)

    def test_canonical_dump_of_seen_restock(self):
        state = {'stock': {}, 'requests': {},
                 'seen': {'e': {'qty': 1, 'sku': 'A', 'op': 'restock',
                                'id': 'e'}}}
        text = dump_state(state)
        # sort_keys=True sorts nested keys too
        self.assertIn('"state":{"requests":{},"seen":{"e":{"id":"e",'
                      '"op":"restock","qty":1,"sku":"A"}},"stock":{}}',
                      text)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
